headline: BoJ Governor Ueda Says Moderate Inflation Revives Japanese Corporate Investment
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda stated that moderate inflation is encouraging corporate risk appetite, with capital expenditure exceeding its early-1990s peak and bank lending expanding over 5%.
why: The Bank of Japan's monetary framework influences global capital flows, yen exchange rates, and Japanese sovereign debt markets.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Expanding corporate investment and credit growth point to improving macroeconomic fundamentals.
